# Big Smile Orthodontics

> Top-rated orthodontic practice in Round Rock, TX, founded and led by Dr. Saba Asrar, a board-certified orthodontist and Platinum Invisalign Provider.

## About

Big Smile Orthodontics is an orthodontic practice located at 1025 Sendero Springs Dr, Suite 110, Round Rock, TX 78681. The practice is founded and led by Dr. Saba Asrar, a board-certified orthodontist with extensive training and a member of the 3M Innovative Orthodontics Advisory Board. The practice has earned 350+ five-star reviews and is recognized for delivering high-quality, personalized orthodontic care.

## Services

- Traditional metal braces
- Invisalign (clear aligners) — Platinum Provider
- Ceramic braces
- Retainers and post-treatment care
- Free initial consultations

## Location & Contact
